blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: The bar where Tom works lost its license because they had been selling alcoholic drinks to minors.
exercises.ru: Бар, в котором работал Том, лишили лицензии ___ того, что там продавали спиртные напитки несовершеннолетним.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This new project in Java doesn't concern me at all, because I'm a PHP developer.
exercises.ru: Этот новый проект на Джаве меня не интересует, ___ я РНР-разработчик.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mary's email was very terse and it was clear that she was upset about something.
exercises.ru: Мэрино письмо было очень сжато, и было понятно, что она ___ чего-то расстроена.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The hood has broken, and so the greasy fumes from cooking are now spreading throughout the kitchen.
exercises.ru: Вытяжка сломалась, и ___ жирные испарения при готовке теперь распространяются по всей кухне.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The main streets of many small towns have been all but abandoned thanks, in large part, to behemoths like Wal-Mart.
exercises.ru: Главные улицы множества маленьких городов были заброшены, в первую очередь, ___ бегемотов вроде Вал-Марта.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Sooner or later, we'll have to buy a new TV as ours is a very old model.
exercises.ru: Рано или поздно нам придётся купить новый телевизор, ___ наш очень старой конструкции.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Because I don't want to marry, my grandmother called me messed up.
exercises.ru: ___ того, что я не хочу выходить замуж, моя бабушка называет меня ущербной.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom really wanted to see echidnas and wombats, so he took a plane to Austria.
exercises.ru: Тому очень хотелось увидеть ехидн и вомбатов, ___ он полетел самолетом в Австрию.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Since they had forgotten their theater tickets, they decided to take a walk down the sidewalk.

exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The dishes are piling up in the sink because we've run out of dishwashing detergent.
exercises.ru: В раковине скапливается посуда, ___ у нас закончилось средство для мытья посуды.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Due to his courtesy and his winning smile, Tom gets along well with both men and women.

exercises.q: With his mother very sick and a tight deadline at work, Tom has a lot on his plate at the moment.
exercises.ru: Мать Тома сильно больна, а на работе поджимают сроки, ___ сейчас у него много забот.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: With Go's unique handicap system, you will be able to play with anyone in the world on even terms.
